title: Shelly Manne & His Men At The Black Hawk Vol 2 CD OJC Contemporary Jazz
conditionDescription: Pre-owned. Disc, jewel case and inserts show normal light wear consistent with age and storage. Please review photos for exact condition.
descriptionText:
Shelly Manne & His Men At The Black Hawk, Vol. 2
(Contemporary / Original Jazz Classics OJCCD-657-2, S7578).
UPC 025218665728. AAD. Total time 62:00.

Volume Two of four albums recorded in actual performance at
San Francisco's famed modern jazz club, September 1959.
Produced by Lester Koenig; remastering 1991 by Phil De Lancie at
Fantasy Studios, Berkeley.

Shelly Manne, drums; Joe Gordon, trumpet; Richie Kamuca, tenor
saxophone; Victor Feldman, piano; Monty Budwig, bass.

1. Step Lightly (12:38)
2. What's New (13:23)
3. Vamp's Blues (19:49)
4. Step Lightly - alternate version, previously unissued (14:13)
5. Theme: A Gem From Tiffany (0:15)

Disc, jewel case and pictured inserts are included. You will receive the exact CD pictured.
